hero.title: Bachelor’s Electrical Engineering in Mauritius
hero.subtitle: A degree in Electrical Engineering in Mauritius is an undergraduate course for students who want to study electrical power systems, electronics, industrial automation, renewable energy and electrical equipment. Related undergraduate degrees can be found in Mauritius, including BEng (Hons) Electrical and Electronic Engineering at the University of Mauritius and BEng (Hons) Electrical and Electronic Engineering Technology at Université des Mascareignes. These options make Electrical Engineering in Mauritius for Indian Students a course worth exploring.
